reasons.plausibility: It aligns well with established principles of kinetic trapping in multicomponent alloys and convincingly explains how rapid quenching can maintain a metastable single phase.
reasons.testability: A clear and specific experiment is proposed (varying cooling rates/dwell times while holding other factors constant) with straightforward structural/chemical analysis to confirm or refute the predicted phase segregation.
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses how processing conditions influence phase stability in high-entropy nanoparticles, offering concrete guidance for controlling microstructure and enabling further exploration of composition-processing-property relationships.
